definition: a pear-shaped fruit with a rough green skin and creamy pale flesh
hook: The Aztecs named this fruit after a body part. You eat it on toast.
modernAnchor: You smash it on bread. You add lime and salt. You pay nine dollars for it at brunch.
journey: The Aztecs looked at the fruit hanging in pairs from the tree and saw an obvious resemblance.
They named it ahuacatl. The same word they used for the part of the body it resembled.
Spanish conquistadors couldn't pronounce ahuacatl, so they twisted it into aguacate, then avocado.
Every time you order guacamole, you are technically asking for a bowl of mashed Aztec testicles.
